exposure: Reduction of hospital stay at the maternity unit (1-day reduction)
outcome: Neonatal readmissions during the first 28 days postpartum
Maternal readmissions during the first 6 weeks postpartum
cohort: The study included 6009 births from all patients who delivered at a tertiary referral centre in Belgium between January 01, 2010, and November 30, 2015.
finding: A reduction in hospital stay at the maternity unit was linked with a significant increase in neonatal readmissions within the first 28 days postpartum, particularly for icterus, but had no significant effect on maternal readmissions.
followup_time: Neonatal readmissions for 28 days postpartum; Maternal readmissions for 6 weeks postpartum
